release_notes: The Bosch AUTODOME IP starlight 7000 HD (VG5-7130) is a 720p IP PTZ speed dome on Bosch's CPP4 platform, with a 1/3-inch Exmor starlight CMOS, 30x optical zoom, 90 dB WDR, and Intelligent Tracking with on-board Intelligent Video Analytics. H.264 quad streaming; mechanical day/night (IR-cut filter, no IR illuminator); dual power (High PoE / 24 VAC) in an IP66/NEMA 4X pendant or IP54 in-ceiling housing.
